Smile confidence

Invisible braces

A discreet approach to straighter teeth.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

Clear aligners can move teeth gradually through a planned sequence of removable trays. The right approach depends on your bite, oral health and the movement required. Ask the team which aligner options they currently provide.

What to expect

  1. Assess your teeth, bite and goals.
  2. Discuss the proposed plan and daily wear requirements.
  3. Review progress and plan retention after treatment.

A common question

How long will treatment take?

Your clinician can estimate the duration after assessing your teeth. Complexity and wearing the aligners as instructed affect progress.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
